A base sherd fragment from a Roman Gaulish samian ware cup or small bowl possibly Dragendorff Form 33 dating to AD 70 - 230. The sherd has a chamfered foot base. There is the remains of a maker's stamp with only one letter 'M' present. The fragment has a pink fabric and is coated in a red slip on both the inside and outside.
